gate: label mask AND negative Morgan Tanimoto >= 0.8; no positive structure constraint
gradient_diagnostic: first batch of every epoch, weighted auxiliary versus regression on shared encoder/pool parameters, before clipping
inference: unchanged original single-molecule model, no projection computation
budget: four fits, no tuning, no official test
sampler: all four arms use identical batches: 29 ordinary training molecules plus one complete training-only triad; each ordinary molecule once per epoch; triad occurrences repeated; 91 batches, 2905 sample occurrences per epoch
